advice: Baseline CBC, LFT, RFT, HBsAg, anti-HCV, HIV, chest X-ray; repeat CBC/LFT every 2-4 weeks initially. Take only once a week. No alcohol. Avoid pregnancy during and 3 months after. Report mouth ulcers, fever or sore throat. Never take cotrimoxazole (Septran/Bactrim) with methotrexate; avoid regular NSAIDs, and tell every doctor you are on methotrexate. Men should also avoid fathering a child during treatment and for 3 months after.
name: Psoriasis (extensive) – methotrexate

rx.instr: Once a WEEK on a fixed day (e.g. Sunday); adjust 7.5-15 mg/week
